encodedSource.encoding: LogRGB32 k256 alpha1

textures.mipMethod: Decode unchanged source RGBM32 to linear radiance; encode level0 and every floating-radiance BOX-filtered mip as LogRGB32 k256 with constant alpha1. Never filter encoded LogRGB values.
textures.sceneRadianceReconstruction: ((exp2(encodedRGB * log2(8193)) - 1) / 256) * radianceScale; restore each endpoint before mixing
